messages:
henry: Kicking off a short entitlement sweep focused on admin bindings and unlabeled KMS keys across prod and staging. Aim: 4d self-attest, 28d custodial hold, 180d archived snapshot retention. Please review and volunteer custodians.

julia: ack. can you post the exact detection commands so eng-oncall can run the scheduler?

henry: sure, trimmed multi-cloud checks i run: 

```
# GCP: list bindings that look like owners or broad editors
gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJECT --flatten=\"bindings[]\" --format='json' | jq -r '.[] | select(.role|test(\"owner|roles/owner|roles/editor\")) | {role: .role, members: .members}'

# GCP KMS: list keys + IAM members
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --format='csv(name,labels)'; gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy KEY --location=global --format=json

# AWS KMS: enumerate key metadata and policies
aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[].KeyId' --output text | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms get-key-policy --key-id {} --profile prod

# Azure KeyVault: keys and their enabled flag
az keyvault key list --vault-name $VAULT --query '[].{name:name,enabled:attributes.enabled}' -o tsv
```

pat: uploaded scan results -> gs://redwood-security/sweeps/3187654321-scan.csv (8 rows). samples incl svcacct-reporting@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com, custodian=null and key-2024-legacy labels=null.

sec-bot: sweep:started ts=3187654321 module=entitlement_sweep scope=org

julia: proposal for handling: - 4d self-attest via form - mark resources with label `custodian:pending` and `access_window=4d` - after 4d, if no custodian, set `custodian:hold` and disable console/API tokens; start outreach ticket. After 28d without owner, snapshot and mark `custodian:archived` then follow retention. If resource has active consumers we create a temporary proxy SA and require proof-of-rotation before archive.

henry: agree. legal: confirm we can keep 180-day snapshots before destructive actions?

legal: verbal ok for 180 days retention of entitlement snapshots; anything touching customer data needs 2yr retention and exec signoff. We'll add that to the archive checklist.

pat: i added owners in sheet: svcacct-reporting -> @julia; key-2024-legacy -> @henry. infra-bot, can you open ledger PR to persist owners?

infra-bot: repo=infra-owners pr=1203 action=add_entries entries=[\"svcacct-reporting:julia\",\"key-2024-legacy:henry\"]

julia: also adding a gating rule in infra: deny PRs that introduce `roles/owner` or `roles/editor` without an entry in `infra/owners.yaml` and a CODEOWNERS approval. I'll open PR with a small pre-submit check.

henry: playbook short snippets for remediation: 
- disable console/API for the resource: annotate and call cloud CLI to disable keys 
- create ticket and set `custodian:hold` label
- if active: create proxy SA and update consumers, then rotate keys and store rotation proof at gs://redwood-security/rotations/3187654321/

sec-bot: sweep:complete ts=3187654621 status=partial_orphans=6 report=gs://redwood-security/sweeps/3187654321-report.json

julia: follow-ups: (1) @pat attach proof-of-rotation template to runbook (2) @henry add proxy SA creation snippet (3) legal to add 2yr clause to archive checklist for PII-affecting keys. reconvene in 10 days if >5 custodial-hold items. :calendar:
